description.value: Forbidden Zone Pizza & Specialty Coffee Bar is a gourmet pizza and specialty coffee destination in Campbell River with roughly 16 years of history, built around hand-pressed dough, house-made Forbidden Pizza sauce, and locally sourced ingredients. Beyond pizza, the menu spans breakfast items, baked pasta, and specialty espresso drinks, making it an all-day stop. A small outdoor seating area rounds out the experience for those who want to eat outside.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business as a legitimate gourmet pizza and specialty coffee restaurant in Campbell River at 2207-D Glenmore Road, with takeout/delivery and gluten-free menu items clearly stated. OSM supplies outdoor_seating=yes and capacity=6, consistent with the website's confirmation of a small outdoor seating area. No evidence of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; phone (778) 420-1990 taken from website only.
OSM record contains no full street address; address taken from website ('2207-D Glenmore Road, Campbell River'). OSM addr:unit=D is consistent with the -D unit suffix.
Opening hours data is inconsistent across the website's own pages and also differs from the OSM opening_hours tag — visitors should verify current hours directly with the business.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, long-established food service business in Campbell River offering diverse menu options including gluten-free, outdoor seating, and takeout — a practical all-day stop for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.
